newsitem.title: CROATIA: Bomb goes off in Zagreb, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Bomb goes off in Zagreb, no injuries.

text.p: A bomb exploded in central Zagreb early on Thursday but no one was injured, police told state radio.
An explosive device went off at 4.30 a.m. (0230 GMT) in front of a jeans shop, damaging the door and shop window, a police statement said. "No one was injured in the explosion," it added.
The police did not say what kind of explosive was used or if there were any suspects.
